title: Clean Air Law, 5768-2008 (חוק אוויר נקי, התשס"ח-2008)
citation: Clean Air Law, 5768-2008, Sefer HaChukkim 2174 of 31 July 2008, p. 752
evidence: Section 93(a) of the Act as published: "תחילתו של חוק זה ביום כ"ה בטבת התשע"א (1 בינואר 2011) (בחוק זה - יום התחילה)"; section 93(b): "תחילתו של סעיף 38 ארבעה חודשים מיום פרסומו של חוק זה." Read in https://fs.knesset.gov.il//17/law/17_lsr_299971.pdf on 2026-11-02. The OData record KNS_IsraelLaw(2000055) gives the same start (ValidityStartDate 2011-01-01).
notes: Record text is the Act as first published in Hebrew, the whole publication from the title to the signatures (chapters, the five schedules and the indirect-amendment sections); the issue cover and contents page are left out. Section 38 started four months after publication, earlier than the Act. One record only: the Knesset database serves publications (Sefer HaChukkim) and no consolidated text, so the five later amendments listed by KNS_LawBinding (the latest publication is 2024-04-16 per KNS_IsraelLaw) are not stored, and the record is the 2008 wording, not the wording in force today. Text made from a PDF whose pages carry the text twice (SOURCES.md ## Israel); checked word by word against a second extractor on 41 of 44 pages. English: no government translation found. Looked for in the OData document list of the bill (KNS_DocumentBill: Hebrew first-reading text, Hebrew plenum extracts, the Hebrew Sefer HaChukkim PDF, no English document) and on www.sviva.gov.il (connection failed from the cloud address); not stored.

title: Protection of the Environment (Emissions and Transfers to the Environment - Reporting Duties and Register) Law, 5772-2012 (חוק הגנת הסביבה (פליטות והעברות לסביבה - חובות דיווח ומרשם), התשע"ב-2012)
evidence: The Act as published has no commencement section (its sections 1 to 39 end with first-report dates: section 39(a) "מפעל ימסור דיווח שנתי ראשון לעניין שנת הכספים 2012 ... עד יום כ"ב בתמוז התשע"ג (30 ביוני 2013)"). The issue is dated "ט' בניסן התשע"ב 1 באפריל 2012". Read in https://fs.knesset.gov.il//18/law/18_lsr_301394.pdf on 2026-11-02. No official page opened states a commencement date.
notes: Pollutant release and transfer register (PRTR): facilities in the Second Schedule report emissions and transfers over the First Schedule thresholds each year to a public register. The record is dated 2012-04-01, the publication date, because a record needs a date and the lookup policy dates an instrument with no commencement clause by its issue date; it is not a stated commencement date. Record text is the Act as first published, Hebrew, from the title to the signatures and both schedules; the correction notice for another law printed after it in the same issue is left out. One record only (no consolidation is served; KNS_LawBinding lists one later amendment). Known limit of the text: in the First Schedule table of pollutants, parentheses and dashes next to Latin substance names can sit on the wrong side, and the signature names come out letter-spaced. The implementing regulations (the 2013 regulations on reducing financial sanctions, Reshumot 7303 p. 194, and the 2014 order changing the Second Schedule, Reshumot 7359 p. 990) are listed in the Knesset database without a PDF and are not in scope. English: no government translation found. Looked for in the OData document list of the bill (KNS_DocumentBill: Hebrew first-reading text, Hebrew plenum extracts, the Hebrew Sefer HaChukkim PDF, no English document) and on www.sviva.gov.il (connection failed from the cloud address); not stored.

title: Consumer Protection Law, 5741-1981 (חוק הגנת הצרכן, התשמ"א-1981), section 2 (deception)
evidence: Section 43 of the Act as published: "תחילתו של חוק זה ביום א' באב התשמ"א (1 באוגוסט 1981)". Read in https://fs.knesset.gov.il//9/law/9_lsr_209363.PDF on 2026-11-02.
notes: Umbrella for environmental claims: section 2(a) forbids a dealer from any act or omission "העלול להטעות צרכן, בכל ענין מהותי בעסקה" (liable to mislead a consumer in any material matter of a transaction). Link only, two reasons. The 1981 PDF has a text layer that looks like OCR (a stray "■" glyph, soft hyphens in place of dashes, brackets mirrored, "פרק אי" for a chapter letter), and it was not checked against the page image. The only version the Knesset database serves is the 1981 Act as enacted, while the Act has been amended repeatedly (KNS_IsraelLaw gives a latest publication of 2026-07-28 and status תקף), so a stored 1981 text would be the wrong law for any later date. English: no government translation found. Looked for in the OData document list of the bill (KNS_DocumentBill: Hebrew first-reading text, Hebrew plenum extracts, the Hebrew Sefer HaChukkim PDF, no English document) and on www.sviva.gov.il (connection failed from the cloud address); not stored.
status_note: Link only: 1981 text layer not trusted and only the as-enacted wording is served; the row IL-KNESSET-ADOPTED itself passes.

title: Securities Regulations (Periodic and Immediate Reports), 5730-1970 (תקנות ניירות ערך (דוחות תקופתיים ומיידיים), התש"ל-1970)
citation: Securities Regulations (Periodic and Immediate Reports), 5730-1970, as amended; latest amendment seen: Amendment No. 2, 5782-2022, Reshumot 10198 of 7 June 2022, p. 3134
evidence: The page is the Knesset OData record of the latest amendment (Id 2191945, status פורסם ברשומות, PublicationDate 2022-06-07). The principal 1970 regulations are not in the Knesset secondary-legislation list, only their amendments; no official page opened states the date the 1970 text took effect.
notes: Candidate vehicle for an ESG or climate disclosure duty on reporting corporations. Not found: the Knesset list of amendments to these regulations (KNS_SecondaryLaw, names containing דוחות תקופתיים ומיידיים) has two entries since the 24th Knesset, 2021-12-29 (Reshumot 9852 p. 1420) and 2022-06-07 (Reshumot 10198 p. 3134), neither read, and none with a sustainability or climate word in its title; so no sustainability disclosure amendment is confirmed. The ISA review report on environmental-risk disclosure (register row, F7) is staff guidance, not an amendment. Link only: the principal text has no PDF in the Knesset store and Reshumot (gov.il) refused the cloud address.
status_note: Link only: principal 1970 text not served by the Knesset PDF store; Reshumot blocked (row IL-RESHUMOT-ADOPTED permission requested).

title: Fuel Excise Order (Imposition of Excise) (Amendment No. 2 and Temporary Provision No. 2), 5784-2024 (צו הבלו על דלק (הטלת בלו) (תיקון מס' 2 והוראת שעה מס' 2), התשפ"ד-2024), pricing of local pollutant and greenhouse-gas emissions
citation: Kovetz HaTakanot (customs, purchase tax and compulsory payments rates) 2129 of 4 September 2024, p. 286
evidence: Section 5(a) of the order: "תחילתו של צו זה ביום א' בטבת התשפ"ה (1 בינואר 2025)", on condition that by 24 December 2024 the Finance Minister publishes the carbon-tax adaptation grant procedure and the carbon-capture grant procedure; section 5(c) defers the start to "י"ב בטבת התשפ"ו (1 בינואר 2026)" if not, with a notice to be published in Reshumot by 31 January 2025. The notice was not read, so which date applied is not stated by any page opened. Read in https://fs.knesset.gov.il/25/SecondaryLaw/25_scl_rv_4908147.pdf on 2026-11-02.
notes: The carbon pricing measure by excise decided in 2024: the order sets an excise on fuels by emissions content, with the customs tariff order (il-customs-tariff-order-2024) set out in the same issue. The Knesset Finance Committee approved both on 2024-09-11 (OData KNS_SecondaryLaw 2214964 and 2214962, status הושלם טיפול). Orders (צווים) are not named in section 6 of the Copyright Law (Acts and regulations are), and no text read says an order is a regulation, so the order is not stored under IL-KNESSET-ADOPTED. Not an ETS: no cap or allowances.
status_note: Link only: an order, not named in Copyright Law s.6; commencement conditional and deferral notice not read.

title: Bank of Israel, Proper Conduct of Banking Business Directive 345: Principles for the effective management of climate-related financial risks
citation: Proper Conduct of Banking Business Directive 345, Circular 2747 of 11 June 2023
evidence: Commencement chapter of the English text: "This directive shall go into effect within 24 months from the day it is published." The update table gives "Circular no. 2747, Version 1, Original circular, June 11, 2023". Read in https://boi.org.il/media/1quhabaa/345_et.pdf (sha256 6aafbfcc...) on 2026-11-02. No fixed commencement date is stated.
notes: Supervisory principles for banking corporations: governance, internal control, risk management, monitoring and internal reporting, scenario analysis. Not a public disclosure duty. Link only: the Bank of Israel terms page was blocked from the cloud address, so the row is permission requested.
